summary: Tournament, registered-team, and guest-team identity writes are ownership-bound, type- and catalog-constrained, and covered on create and update paths. The Firestore emulator suite passed 198 tests.

checks.updateBypass: Tournament create and update both call validTournamentDocument. Registered-team and guest-team logo changes call validTeamLogoUrl when the field changes, while vice captains can change only logoUrl to an allowlisted preset.
checks.authoritySource: Tournament authority comes from the existing resource organizerId. Registered-team authority comes from the existing ownerId and viceCaptainIds. Guest-team updates use the existing creatorId; no newly supplied role field grants authority.
checks.businessLogic: Tournament organizers can save a tournament emblem; registered-team owners, vice captains, and guest-team creators can save a team badge or pennant without gaining unrelated write access.
checks.storageAbuse: Tournament and team presets use exact allowlists. Creator-managed HTTPS logo URLs are limited to 2048 characters and reject non-HTTPS schemes.
checks.typeSafety: Optional identity fields accept null or bounded strings that match the intended source policy.
checks.fieldLevelSecurity: Vice-captain updates require affectedKeys().hasOnly(['logoUrl']) in addition to existing-team membership authority.
